Add more anchors by copying .ml, .der, .cer, .crt or .pem files to Android/data/com.ismoilovdev.chipid/files/csca/.

PACE or BAC opens an encrypted channel with the key from the MRZ or CAN. Passive Authentication checks every data group against the signed security object (SOD) and the signer certificate against the issuing country\'s CSCA. Chip or Active Authentication proves the chip holds a private key that cannot be copied. Standards: ICAO Doc 9303, BSI TR-03110.

JMRTD (LGPL 3.0), SCUBA (LGPL 3.0), Bouncy Castle (MIT), Inter and JetBrains Mono (SIL OFL 1.1), CameraX (Apache 2.0), ML Kit text recognition (Google ML Kit terms). CSCA master list: German Federal Office for Information Security (BSI).
